secondary.description: Bringing new into being vs. passing forward what exists

songs.name: Songs

symbol.name: Musical note bursting into birds
symbol.description: A musical note with birds emerging from it, representing spontaneous expression taking flight
symbol.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><ellipse cx="28" cy="75" rx="18" ry="12" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="44" y="30" width="6" height="45" fill="currentColor"/><path d="M 55 35 Q 58 32, 62 35 Q 65 32, 68 35" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M 60 25 Q 64 22, 68 25 Q 72 22, 76 25" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M 65 15 Q 70 12, 75 15 Q 80 12, 85 15" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

songs.visual_style: Bright, airy watercolor washes in alpine meadow colors (sky blues, grass greens, wildflower yellows and pinks). Loose, flowing compositions with movement and wind. Light-drenched, impressionistic. The aesthetic of being outdoors, spinning with arms wide. Think Julie Andrews on the mountainside - pure, uncontained joy.

mountains.name: Mountains

symbol.name: Alpine peaks
symbol.description: Three mountain peaks representing ancient enduring wisdom

upright: Songs sung for a thousand years

mountains.visual_style: Solid, monumental compositions in weathered stone grays, deep earth browns, snow whites, and distant blue-grays. Strong vertical elements, sense of scale and permanence. Romanticist landscape tradition - Caspar David Friedrich, sublime and enduring. The aesthetic of geological time, of things that were here before us and will remain after.

puppets.name: Puppets

symbol.name: Marionette control bar
symbol.description: A puppet control bar with strings, representing skillful craft or manipulation
symbol.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="25" y="20" width="50" height="8" rx="2" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="47" y="15" width="6" height="18" rx="1" fill="currentColor"/><line x1="30" y1="28" x2="25" y2="75" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="50" y1="28" x2="45" y2="75" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="50" y1="28" x2="55" y2="75" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="70" y1="28" x2="75" y2="75" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="25" cy="75" r="3" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="45" cy="75" r="3" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="55" cy="75" r="3" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="75" cy="75" r="3" fill="currentColor"/></svg>

puppets.visual_style: Theatrical lighting - sharp contrasts between spotlight and shadow, rich jewel tones (deep reds, golds, purples) against black backgrounds. Stagecraft aesthetic - visible strings, dramatic angles, exaggerated gestures. Art Deco meets German Expressionist theater. The aesthetic of constructed spectacle, whether charming or sinister.

whistles.name: Whistles

symbol.name: Naval boatswain's whistle
symbol.description: A ship's whistle representing discipline, order, and transmitted structure
symbol.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><mask id="whistle-mask"><rect width="100" height="100" fill="white"/><circle cx="55" cy="50" r="8" fill="black"/></mask></defs><ellipse cx="55" cy="50" rx="25" ry="18" fill="currentColor" mask="url(#whistle-mask)"/><rect x="10" y="45" width="30" height="10" rx="3" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="75" cy="45" r="4" fill="currentColor"/></svg>

whistles.visual_style: Precise, geometric compositions in naval and institutional colors - navy blues, crisp whites, polished brass, iron grays. Clean lines, symmetry, regimentation. The aesthetic of uniforms, insignia, architectural plans. Bauhaus clarity that can tip into authoritarian coldness. Images suggest both protective order and potential oppression.
